test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

I bought a _____ but it is _____.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence reads: "I bought a _____ but it is _____."
 
• The correct option is "chip" and "cheap" (Option 2) because it forms a logical and meaningful sentence.
 
• "Chip" refers to a small piece or item, and "cheap" means inexpensive.
 
• The other options do not form a meaningful sentence in the given context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I bought a chip__ but it is __cheap__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cake, Cane:** These words do not form a meaningful pair in the context.
 
• **Cheap, Chip:** This arrangement (Option 3) is illogical as it does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• **Cane, Cane:** Repeating the word "cane" makes the sentence redundant and meaningless.
